title: Job
description: Persisted state for one transcript+slides video job. Stored as the `data` JSON column of one row in the `jobs` MySQL table (see backend/schema.sql) and treated as the single source of truth for backend/worker.py and the UI's status polling.

phase.description: Coarse pipeline phase. 'prepare' covers everything up to and including TTS synthesis (the paid/slow steps). 'ready_for_render' is the dry-run checkpoint. 'rendering'/'done' cover the local, free, repeatable video-assembly step.

step.description: Fine-grained step within the current phase, for UI progress display.

params.description: Everything the UI submits at job creation. Immutable for phase 1; transition/aspect fields may be edited and re-applied for a cheap re-render without redoing phase 1.

targetDurationSeconds.description: Snap points for 45s / 90s / 3min / 5min. A raw integer is allowed too if the UI later exposes a custom-seconds field.

narrationStyle.description: Free-text tone/expertise instruction for the condensation prompt, e.g. 'explain like a park ranger, plain language' or 'academic hydrology lecture'. Distinct from voice.

presetVoiceId.description: ElevenLabs voice_id from the curated dropdown. Required when mode=preset.

customDescription.description: Freeform voice description for ElevenLabs Voice Design, e.g. '50s male, Scottish accent, warm documentary narrator'. Required when mode=custom.

resolvedVoiceId.description: Filled in during 'resolving_voice'. For mode=custom this is cached in data/voice-cache.json keyed by a hash of customDescription so repeat runs with the same description don't regenerate a voice.

minSlideSeconds.description: Floor on how long a slide is held even if its narration audio is shorter than this.

pdfs.description: Exactly one entry must have role='primary'. UI enforces this with a radio control; a single uploaded PDF is auto-assigned primary.

order.description: User-set drag order among multiple PDFs; primary need not be order 0.

slides.description: Flattened, ordered-by-extraction list of every page across every PDF (pre-alignment). Populated during 'extracting_pdfs'.

textPath.description: pdftotext output for this page, used as supplementary context alongside the image itself.

manusFileId.description: File ID after upload to Manus Files API.

alignment.description: Manus's vision+text alignment output: which slide(s), in what order, map to which part of the transcript. Populated during 'aligning'.

notes.description: Manus's rationale, kept for the human review UI, e.g. 'chart matches narration about flow rates'.

narration.description: Condensed per-segment script sized to the target duration. Populated during 'condensing_narration'. This plus 'slides' is the human-reviewable 'script' the dry-run switch stops at.

audio.description: One synthesized clip per narration segment, in the same order. Populated during 'synthesizing_audio' / 'probing_durations'. Reaching phase=ready_for_render requires this array to be fully populated with real durations.

render.description: Populated by the (separate, repeatable) Phase 2 render workflow. Not touched by Phase 1.

outputPath.description: Path of the most recent render.

renderCount.description: Incremented each time phase 2 re-renders with different transition params, so old outputs can be kept or pruned.

history.description: One entry per render, oldest first. Each re-render (e.g. trying a different transition) appends here rather than overwriting; params.transition itself is never mutated by phase 2.

transition.description: The transition params actually used for this render, including any CLI overrides.
